snippet.title: PlayStation - NBA In the Zone 2 (1996)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Incredibly realistic 3D texture-mapped players provide unsurpassed basketball action!
- All 29 NBA Teams with full 12-man rosters
- Full season and playoff modes
- Trades
- Substitutions
- Create your own player
- Post Plays
- Fouls
- Multiple Camera Angles
- Play by Play Announcer
- And more!
